         if converter is None:
             return False
 
+        adopted = False
+        if self.units is None:
+            # If this axis is shared with an axis that already has units for the
+            # same converter, reuse those units rather than creating new ones,
+            # which would trigger unit-change callbacks on all shared axes (and
+            # in turn clobber their data limits).
+            for shared_axis in self._get_shared_axis():
+                if (shared_axis is not self
+                        and shared_axis.units is not None
+                        and isinstance(shared_axis.converter,
+                                       type(converter))):
+                    self.units = shared_axis.units
+                    self.converter = shared_axis.converter
+                    adopted = True
+                    break
+
         neednew = self.converter != converter
-        self.converter = converter
+        if not adopted:
+            self.converter = converter
         default = self.converter.default_units(data, self)
         if default is not None and self.units is None:
             self.set_units(default)
